from z3 import *
import itertools
v = 15
colors = 4
poss_edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(v), 2))
e_vars = {(i, j): Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}') for i, j in poss_edges}
col = [[Bool(f'c_{u}_{c}') for c in range(colors)] for u in range(v)]
s = Solver()
# each vertex at least one color
for u in range(v):
    s.add(Or([col[u][c] for c in range(colors)]))
# at most one color
for u in range(v):
    for c1, c2 in itertools.combinations(range(colors), 2):
        s.add(Not(And(col[u][c1], col[u][c2])))
# if edge, different colors
def get_e(a, b):
    return e_vars[(min(a, b), max(a, b))]
for (i, j), ev in e_vars.items():
    for c in range(colors):
        s.add(Implies(ev, Not(And(col[i][c], col[j][c]))))
# no C3
for a, b, c in itertools.combinations(range(v), 3):
    s.add(Not(And(get_e(a, b), get_e(b, c), get_e(a, c))))
# no C4
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(v), 4):
    w, x, y, z = comb
    # three possible cycles
    s.add(Not(And(get_e(w, x), get_e(x, y), get_e(y, z), get_e(z, w))))
    s.add(Not(And(get_e(w, x), get_e(x, z), get_e(z, y), get_e(y, w))))
    s.add(Not(And(get_e(w, y), get_e(y, x), get_e(x, z), get_e(z, w))))
# no C5
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(v), 5):
    m = min(comb)
    others = [x for x in comb if x != m]
    for p in itertools.permutations(others):
        cycle = [m] + list(p)
        if cycle[1] < cycle[4]:
            s.add(Not(And(get_e(cycle[0], cycle[1]), get_e(cycle[1], cycle[2]), get_e(cycle[2], cycle[3]), get_e(cycle[3], cycle[4]), get_e(cycle[4], cycle[0]))))
# at least 23 edges
s.add(Sum([If(ev, 1, 0) for ev in e_vars.values()]) >= 23)
print(s.check())
